# convertRichTextToHtml

<link-summary>Renders a rich text cell value as HTML.</link-summary>

<web-summary>convertRichTextToHtml() — Renders a rich text cell value as HTML. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet</code> · Since: 1.0.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function convertRichTextToHtml(richText: GoogleAppsScript.Spreadsheet.RichTextValue): string;
```

Each run of the value becomes a span carrying the styles it had — weight, slant, underline, strikethrough, colour, size and family — and a link becomes an anchor. The text itself is escaped, so a cell holding `<b>` comes out as text and not as markup.

## Parameters

| Parameter  | Type                                         | Description                    |
| :--------- | :------------------------------------------- | :----------------------------- |
| `richText` | `GoogleAppsScript.Spreadsheet.RichTextValue` | The rich text value to render. |

## Returns

`string` — the HTML.

## Examples

### In use

```javascript
const range = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveRange();

const html = convertRichTextToHtml(range.getRichTextValue());
```
